purpose: Describe the independent, immediate approvals required before any future D1C V3-R1 retry. This local contract does not authorize notebook changes, GPU use, Dataset access, training, output/checkpoint access, Save Version, holdout evaluation, promotion, or serving.
approval_rule: Every authorization is independent, must be explicit and immediate, and a false value blocks the following action. No authorization is inferred from code availability, a mounted release, a blocked-cell check, or a prior D1C attempt.
current_effect: No execution path is permitted. This contract is local documentation only.
